description: This file defines the ViewCatalog interface for managing views within a Spark SQL catalog, including methods for listing, loading, creating, replacing, altering, dropping, and renaming views, as well as handling view properties and exceptions.

classes.name: ViewCatalog
classes.description: Interface for catalog operations related to views, including listing, loading, creating, replacing, altering, dropping, and renaming views, with support for view properties and exceptions.

methods.name: listViews
methods.description: Lists view identifiers within a specified namespace, throwing exception if namespace does not exist.

methods.name: loadView
methods.description: Loads metadata for a specific view identified by an Identifier, throws exception if not found or if a table with the same identifier exists.

methods.name: invalidateView
methods.description: Invalidates cached metadata for a view, forcing reload on next access.

methods.name: viewExists
methods.description: Checks if a view exists for a given identifier, returns false if not found.

methods.name: createView
methods.description: Creates a new view in the catalog with specified view information.

methods.name: replaceView
methods.description: Replaces an existing view or creates it if not present, with optional atomicity.

methods.name: alterView
methods.description: Applies changes to an existing view, rejecting changes if not supported.

methods.name: dropView
methods.description: Deletes a view from the catalog, returns true if deleted.

methods.name: renameView
methods.description: Renames a view, throwing exceptions if source does not exist or target exists.
